Diffs Solana capture files and prints bank, account, and transaction mismatches.

# Purpose
This file implements the `fd_solcap_diff` command-line tool. It reads two Solana capture files in the `solcap` format, aligns them by slot, and compares the bank state for each common slot. The main comparison covers bank hashes and related preimage fields such as `prev_bank_hash`, `account_delta_hash`, `accounts_lt_hash_checksum`, `poh_hash`, `signature_cnt`, and `account_cnt`. When a mismatch is found, the code prints a human-readable report and can also compare account tables and account data in more detail.

The file also contains support for transaction comparison and data export. It can decode transaction metadata from capture chunks, compare Firedancer transaction results between two files, and compare a single file against Solana transaction results when those fields are present. For account mismatches, it can dump raw account data to binary files and, for selected account owners and sysvars, write YAML output by decoding the account data into typed structures. The [`main`](<#main>) function handles command-line options, opens the capture files, creates the scratch workspace, and drives the full diff process.
